title: FormsChromeCopyCatalog
description: The forms chrome copy catalog: the typed (HTML) surface's chrome vocabulary (navigation, buttons, labels, study labels, validation fallbacks) as id + per-language texts, mirroring the voice-resource-catalog shape. The model owns this vocabulary; the forms app consumes the embedded reference contract through a fail-fast loader and the navigation text-map generator reads the same file. User-facing localized text uses correct orthography (JSON-escaped where non-ASCII).

supportedLanguages.description: The chrome's display languages in fallback order; the first is the fallback. Every entry's texts must cover exactly this set (asserted key-by-key in the loader and the sync guards).

Id.description: Identifier: starts with letter/underscore, followed by alphanumerics, dots, dashes, or underscores.
